title: Decision memo: the cost case rests on a run count that the supplied data contradicts, and the plan burns the old system

planted.why: the supplied data shows about 30,000-33,000 runs a month; at $0.06 that is about $1,900-1,950, not $180, so the move costs far more than the VM
the plan destroys the working system the day of cutover, leaving no way back if the new one misbehaves

proof.python:
import csv
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('evidence/run_counts.csv')))
last = int(rows[-1]['runs'])
cost = last * 0.06
assert last > 30000 and cost > 1500, (last, cost)
assert 'Decommission the VM the same day' in open('memo.md').read()
